text:
Hi everyone,

I’m hoping someone here has experience with employing someone on a B/1 partner visa.

I’m supposed to start a new job in 2 days, but my employer’s payroll department and their lawyer are suddenly saying they need to apply for special permission to employ me.

However, I’ve been told by several people that a B/1 partner visa already grants unrestricted work authorization, meaning employers don’t need to apply for a separate permit like they would for a regular foreign worker.

Does anyone have:

* an official source (Population & Immigration Authority, regulations, etc.),
* experience with this situation,
* or know who my employer could contact to clarify this?

I’m already employed in Israel on the same visa, so this has come as a complete surprise. I also signed the contract one month ago and sent my work visa and said I’m unrestricted to work, which was fine back then. 

Also, I found the answer here in this group by the admins, that there’s no permit needed. However, I don’t think I can send my new employer a screenshot of a Facebook group. 

I’d really appreciate any help or references I can send to my employer. Thank you so much!
